descFull: Multi-model AI orchestration where behaviour is Markdown, not code. One coordinator routes scoped task packets to 71 role-based specialists across 5 model families (Codex / Claude / Gemini / Grok / Kimi) — each working in an isolated git worktree, each reviewed by a rival family before it lands. One tmux session, no server.
